name: Manjalaya
notes: Asura princess of shadows summoned by Varunesh through dark tantra and unicorn sacrifice via Dwarka Gate. Skin shifts to radiant violet upon arousal. Mother of the Asura-Tainted Princess. The Shadow Pact is recorded at the Ancient Courts, with the summoning described as taking place through a Dwarka Gate. The gate traditions describe separate incidents in Deep Antiquity and the Migrations. A draft account of her peaceful death remains undated and unlocated.
